description: This PHP class defines the ReviewerRating entity for the OrangeHRM performance management plugin. It maps to the 'ohrm_reviewer_rating' database table and includes properties like id, rating, comment, and relationships to PerformanceReview, Reviewer, and Kpi entities. The class also contains getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: ReviewerRating
classes.description: Entity class representing reviewer ratings, with ORM mapping annotations and properties for rating details and relationships.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment for the rating.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the rating.
